description.value: Grounds for Coffee is a Vancouver institution founded in 1993, built around hand-made cinnamon buns crafted daily from locally-sourced, preservative-free ingredients. The Commercial Drive location also serves premium organic coffee, savory wraps, calzones, house-made flatbread, and a rotating selection of vegan and gluten-free baked goods. A neighbourhood-haven cafe on one of Vancouver's most prominent cycling corridors, it offers online ordering with in-store pickup.
